    1. increaseAmount(int)

Interface AmountIncreasable

All Known Implementing Classes:
Bible
public interface AmountIncreasable
Implemented by weapons that can fire additional projectiles simultaneously.

Accessories call increaseAmount(int) to let qualifying weapons emit more hits, beams, or orbs per activation (e.g. extra Bible books, or extra projectiles from Standard).

  • Method Details

    • increaseAmount

      void increaseAmount(int delta)
      Increases the number of simultaneous projectiles / units by delta.

      A value of 1 adds one extra projectile on top of the current count. Implementations may impose an upper bound.

      Parameters:
      delta - number of additional projectiles to add (must be > 0)
